0022600111.text: The Phoenix Suns (0-1, 15th in the West) host the Golden State Warriors (0-1, 13th in the West) as both teams look for their first win of 2026-27. Phoenix is without Mark Williams, who is out after shoulder surgery, while Luke Kennard (knee strain) and Oso Ighodaro (oblique strain) are day-to-day and listed as game-time decisions. Golden State is missing Charles Bassey (knee), Jimmy Butler III (knee surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (illness), and Moses Moody (knee surgery), and the Warriors won the last meeting 101-97 in Phoenix on February 5, 2026, which was part of a 2025-26 season series the Suns lost 1-3.
